verses.gurmukhi: ਅੰਬਰ ਬੇਚਨ ਜਾਇ ਦੇਸ ਦਿਗੰਬਰਨ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤ ਨ ਹੋਇ ਲਾਭ ਸਹਸੋ ਹੈ ਮੂਲਿ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: a(n)bar bechan jai dhes dhiga(n)baran ke praapat na hoi laabh sahaso hai mool ko ||

en.bdb: If a cloth merchant visits a place where everyone lives naked, he is not going to benefit from it. He may lose his principal goods.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਤਨ ਪਰੀਖਿਆ ਸੀਖਿਆ ਚਾਹੈ ਜਉ ਆਂਧਨ ਪੈ ਰੰਕਨ ਪੈ ਰਾਜ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਭੂਲਿ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: ratan pareekhiaa seekhiaa chaahai jau aa(n)dhan pai ra(n)kan pai raaj maa(n)gai mithiaa bhram bhool ko ||

en.bdb: If a person wishes to learn the science of evaluating gems from a blind person or asks for the kingdom from paupers, that would be his foolishness and mistake.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁੰਗਾ ਪੈ ਪੜ੍ਹਨ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਤਕ ਬੈਦਕ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਬਹਿਰਾ ਪੈ ਰਾਗ ਨਾਦ ਅਨਿਥਾ ਅਭੂਲਿ ਕੋ ॥
verses.translit_en: gu(n)gaa pai paRhan jai jotak baidhak bidhiaa bahiraa pai raag naadh anithaa abhool ko ||

en.bdb: If someone wishes to learn astrology or acquire knowledge of Vedas from a dumb person, or wishes to know about music from a deaf person, this would be an utter foolish effort.

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਆਨ ਦੇਵ ਸੇਵ ਦੋਖ ਮੇਟਿ ਮੋਖ ਚਾਹੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੁਖ ਸਹੈ ਜਮ ਸੂਿਲ ਕੋ ॥੪੭੫॥
verses.translit_en: taise aan dhev sev dhokh meT mokh chaahai bin satigur dhukh sahai jam sooil ko ||475||

en.bdb: Similarly, if anyone tries to get rid of his sins and achieve salvation by serving and worshipping other gods, this would be an act of foolishness. Without the True Guru, he will only bear the pricks of the angels of death. (475)
